leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to represent user roles and authentication state
Implement a context provider to manage and distribute authentication state across components
Apply conditional rendering to display UI elements based on user roles
Construct protected route components that check authentication status before rendering
Utilize React Router's navigation hooks to redirect unauthorized users
Execute role-based access control by comparing user roles against required permissions
Handle authentication state changes and update the UI accordingly
Return appropriate fallback components or loading states during authentication checks
Modify route configurations to wrap specific routes with protection logic
Access authentication context within components to retrieve user role information
Control component visibility by implementing role-based conditional logic
Store and retrieve user authentication data from context for route protection decisions
